auth-client.unix:
Client type: public browser client
Flow: authorization code with PKCE
Redirect URI: https://YOUR_HOST/studio/auth/callback
Logout return URI: https://YOUR_HOST/studio
Access token: signed JWT
Client secret in Studio: none

auth-config.unix:
AUTH_ADAPTER=oidc
IDENTITY_ADMIN_ADAPTER=none
OIDC_ISSUER_URL=https://YOUR_PROVIDER/ISSUER_PATH
OIDC_AUDIENCE=openldr-api
OIDC_WEB_CLIENT_ID=openldr-web
OIDC_SCOPES=openid profile email
auth-config.file: .env, edit existing values; replace provider examples

auth-recreate.unix:
docker compose config --quiet
docker compose up -d --force-recreate api
docker compose logs --tail 100 api
